Title: Critical Environment Operations Manager - Data Center
Description:
**Overview**
Microsoft’s Cloud Infrastructure and Operations (MCIO) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a
**Critical Environment Operations Manager**
, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive and the Microsoft Azure platform.
  
  
Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
  
  
With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Empower a culture of safety, security, and compliance in all aspects of our Datacenter operations
* Lead a team of Mechanical, Electrical and Control System professionals supporting Microsoft's online services
* Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in our Datacenters
* Maximize Critical Environment (CE) availability to ensure optimal operational efficiency
* Reduce high-impact and human-error Critical Environment (CE) incidents year over year
* Deliver on cost/energy efficiency initiatives
* Ensure routine reporting to effectively manage and analyze our Power/Temperature/Relative Humidity, and SLA monitoring
* Establish and enhance strong working relationships and engagement with our Engineering Groups (EGs), and business partners
* Work with regional and global peers to share and build best practices across the entire datacenter portfolio

**Qualifications**
Required/minimum qualifications
  
  

* High School Qualification or equivalent AND 3+ years experience of mission-critical service management (e.g., Data Centers, military, hospitals, power plants, etc. or managing physical operations and/or critical environment infrastructure) OR equivalent experience.

**Background Check Requirements**
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
  
  

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter
* The successful candidate currently has the ability to obtain Reliability Status screening from a duly authorized department or agency of the Government of Canada. This process includes but is not limited to:

+ Verification of identity, background, education, professional credentials, personal and professional references, credit check and criminal background check.
+ Reliability Status screening may also require a security questionnaire and security interview.
+ To obtain the requisite clearance within required timelines, applicants must have five (5) years of continuous Canadian residency and must not have lived or worked outside of Canada for more than six (6) months during that time unless Microsoft is satisfied that the requisite clearance can nevertheless be obtained within required timelines.

**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Technical College Degree in Computer Science, Math, Telecommunications, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering,or related field AND 8+ years experience in critical environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU), OR High School Qualification or equivalent AND 10+ years experience in critical environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU), OR equivalent experience.
* 1+ year(s) people management experience.
* 3+ years experience in leading a diverse, technical team.
* Applicable certifications: ITIL v3 Foundation, Microsoft Operations Framework (MOF) Certifications, Leadership Development Certifications, PMP.
* Experience working on large scale CE projects.

Description:

* 1 year of experience in program management.

Experience managing software integrations.

-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. We focus relentlessly on guaranteeing availability and reliability at scale. The team delivers business growth generating capacity and services at industry-leading intervals. Simply put - we enable the world’s imagination with dependable, universal connectivity.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

* Account financial performance, including revenue, margin, billing, and cost control

Title: Director, Network Development & Operations
Description:
**Xplore Inc. is Canada’s fibre, 5G and satellite broadband company for rural living. Xplore is committed to the relentless pursuit of an improved broadband experience for all Canadians. Xplore is building a world-class fibre optic and 5G wireless network to enable innovative broadband services for better every day rural living, for today and future generations.**
The Director, Network Development & Operations is the senior leader responsible for turning Xplore’s network architecture into an automated, scalable production network, delivering Core & Transport Network Services at a Tier-1 Telco Gold Standard and ensuring uncompromising reliability, security, and performance from the core to the customer. The role leads the teams accountable for detailed IP engineering, DWDM engineering automation, caching implementation, CI/CD, configuration management, telemetry, and operational tooling.
  
  
The Director sets the vision and operating model for network-as-code, ensuring that all IP/MPLS, DWDM, and caching configurations are deployed safely, consistently, and at scale. Under this leadership, the organization builds the automation frameworks, observability pipelines, and operational guardrails that enable high-velocity, low-risk changes across the backbone, reduce manual toil, and strengthen 24×7 operational readiness.
  
  
Working in close partnership with Network Architecture & Technology Strategy, the Director ensures that architectural intent is executed through modern DevOps practices, and brings operational insight back into standards, roadmaps, and long-term network evolution. The Director connects network development and operations directly to business outcomes and KPIs — including reliability, speed of change, customer experience, and cost efficiency — and serves as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on operational performance and automation maturity.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**
Detailed IP, DWDM & Caching Engineering
  
  

* Own detailed IP engineering across BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, MPLS, segment routing, and routing policy.
* Own DWDM configuration automation, including line-system configuration templates, channel provisioning, amplifier and span parameter automation, optical telemetry integration, and operational tooling for DWDM health and performance.
* Own caching platform implementation, including cache node configuration, routing and traffic-steering policies, cache peering and placement logic (as defined by Architecture), and performance tuning and hit-ratio optimization.
* Translate architectural standards into deployable configuration templates and network-as-code artifacts.

Network Automation & CI/CD Pipelines
  
  

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for IP/MPLS/DWDM and caching configuration deployment.
* Implement automated testing, validation, and rollback capabilities.
* Drive adoption of network-as-code across the Core & Transport domain, ensuring all changes are executed through automated, repeatable workflows.

Telemetry, Observability & Operational Tooling
  
  

* Own telemetry pipelines, dashboards, and observability tooling for Core & Transport.
* Ensure real-time visibility into routing behavior, caching performance and hit ratios, DWDM optical health (OSNR, span performance, and alarms), and capacity and traffic patterns.
* Partner with Service Assurance & Observability to integrate signals, alerts, anomaly detection, and automated diagnostics.

Reliability Engineering & Operational Excellence
  
  

* Implement guardrails, automated checks, and configuration validation to reduce operational risk.
* Lead post-incident automation improvements to prevent recurrence.

Partnership with Architecture & Execution of Architectural Intent
  
  

* Implement the logical connectivity, caching strategy, DWDM design parameters, standards, and principles defined by Network Architecture & Technology Strategy.
* Provide feedback loops to Architecture on operational feasibility, automation impacts, and configuration constraints.
* Ensure all deployments align with long-range architectural direction and resiliency goals.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  

* Work closely with Network Architecture & Technology Strategy; Carrier Services; Fiber, Fixed Wireless, and Enterprise teams; and NOC, SRE, and Service Assurance.

Financial & Investment Performance
  
  

* Own the financial and investment performance of the Network Development & Operations portfolio, including capital and operating budgets, business cases, and return-on-investment tracking.
* Drive measurable unit cost improvements (e.g., cost per bit, cost per port, cost per subscriber) through automation, standardization, and platform consolidation.
* Reduce lifecycle risk by proactively managing hardware and software end-of-life and end-of-support exposure, technical debt, and refresh roadmaps across IP, DWDM, and caching platforms.
* Partner with Finance, Architecture, and Procurement to prioritize investments, optimize vendor spend, and align spending with business outcomes.
* Report on financial, unit cost, and lifecycle-risk KPIs to senior leadership.

**The Ideal Candidate Will Possess**

* 15+ years of experience in IP engineering, DWDM engineering automation, caching platforms, or DevOps for large-scale network infrastructure.

Technical Expertise
  
  

* Strong expertise in routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, IS-IS), MPLS/segment routing, and routing policy.
* Hands-on experience with DWDM systems, optical telemetry, and line-system configuration.
* Experience with caching platforms (CDN nodes, edge caches, content caches).
* Experience with automation tools (Ansible, Python, CI/CD frameworks).
* Experience with telemetry, observability, and network monitoring systems.

Leadership & Collaboration
  
  

* Demonstrated ability to lead technical engineering teams and work across Architecture, SRE, Service Assurance, and cross-functional network teams.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to translate architectural intent into executable engineering workflows.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Master’s degree considered an asset, but not required.
* Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CCNP/CCIE, DWDM/optical certifications, cloud or DevOps certifications, Agile/Scrum certifications, SRE certifications, PMP, ITIL) are considered an asset.

**Condition Of Employment**
As a condition of employment and in order to comply with industry related data security standards, this position is subject to the successful completion of a Criminal Background Check. Details will be supplied to applicants as they move through the selection process.

Description:
**Job Description**
**What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?**
At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. WSP are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Digital Delivery Lead to drive digital transformation, BIM excellence, automation initiatives, and digital project delivery across our Transport & Infrastructure business.
  
  
The Infrastructure Digital Delivery Lead is the strategic technology architect responsible for the comprehensive digital lifecycle of our major infrastructure, utility corridors, bridges, and infrastructure master plans. Operating across the entire delivery continuum from conceptual design to asset handover this role unifies BIM, Geospatial Intelligence (GIS), Real-time Digital Twins, Legacy CAD standardizations, High-End 3D Visualizations, and AI-driven workflow automations.
  
  
You will not just manage models; you will design the overarching data infrastructure that connects engineering design to operational asset management, ensuring absolute data integrity, efficiency, and future-proof project delivery.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities & Duties**

* Digital Strategy, Frameworks & BIM Governance
* Author, maintain, and enforce the overarching Digital Delivery Execution Plan (DDEP) and BIM Execution Plans (BEP) in strict compliance with ISO 19650 standards.
* Establish, structure, and administer the Common Data Environment (CDE) using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360, setting up automated review workflows, ISO container compliance, and multi-firm security access permissions.
* Govern project coordinate systems, ensuring zero spatial or coordinate drift across linear highway alignments, utility networks, structural bridges, and global GIS maps.
* GIS & Digital Twin Integration
* Architect the bidirectional data pipelines connecting GIS platforms (Esri ArcGIS / QGIS) with horizontal engineering design software (Civil 3D / OpenRoads).
* Build the schema maps and asset metadata frameworks required to translate 3D BIM data into operational Digital Twin environments (e.g., Autodesk Tandem, Bentley iTwin, or custom web-based twin environments).
* Define asset tracking protocols to integrate future IoT sensor data metadata placeholders within the smart-city asset master list during the design phase.
* CAD Legacy & Hybrid Workflows
* Maintain strict quality control over traditional, two-dimensional deliverables by enforcing uniform CAD standards (layer structures, plot styles, sheet sets) alongside 3D environments.
* Manage hybrid workflows ensuring that legacy 2D drawings dynamically update from the core 3D federated model, minimizing manual drafting errors.
* 3D Visualization & Reality Capture
* Manage large-scale visual aggregation models within Autodesk InfraWorks, Twinmotion, or Unreal Engine to produce high-end, real-time interactive models for public consultation and executive stakeholder reviews.
* Oversite the integration of Reality Capture datasets (UAV Photogrammetry, LiDAR point clouds, mobile scanning) into active design environments for real-time site verification.
* AI Tools, Scripting & Automations
* Develop, scale, and deploy custom automations using Dynamo for Civil 3D/Revit, Python, or VBA to eliminate repetitive drafting tasks, automate grading calculations, and auto-populate asset metadata fields.
* Implement AI-driven design tools and generative design algorithms for optimizing massive earthworks volumes, alternative highway corridor alignments, and automated clash resolution pipelines.
* Utilize AI text and data analytics tools to run predictive automated audits on thousands of model parameters, catching quality drops instantly.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Information Management, Digital Engineering, or related discipline.
* Master's Degree would be advantageous
* Minimum 15 years of professional experience.
* Proven experience leading digital delivery on large-scale transport and infrastructure projects.
* Strong background supporting the design and delivery of:

+ Roads & Highways
+ Rail & Transit
+ Bridges and Structures
+ Utilities
+ Aviation
+ Smart Infrastructure Projects

* Demonstrated success in implementing BIM and digital transformation strategies within engineering consultancies.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary digital delivery teams.
* Experience working in the UAE and/or wider Middle East strongly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of ISO 19650 standards.

**Technical Proficiencies:**

* BIM / Civil Design: Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Civil 3D (corridors, pipes, gradings), InfraWorks, and Revit (structures/bridges).
* Geospatial (GIS): Expert capability in Esri ArcGIS (Pro / Online) and its native integrations with the Autodesk ecosystem.
* Digital Twin & Visualization: Practical understanding of Digital Twin schemas (Asset Information Models) and real-time rendering environments (InfraWorks, Enscape, Twinmotion).
* Automation & Coding: Proficient with Dynamo, Python, or visual programming tools. Experience with AI prompt engineering or AI plugins for design optimization is highly valued.
* Collaboration & CAD: Mastery of Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) alongside classic AutoCAD Architecture/Civil workflows.

Reporting to the DPWES IT Director and working closely with the Wastewater Treatment Division (WTD), Wastewater Collection Division (WCD), and Wastewater Planning and Monitoring Division (WPMD) directors, you will serve as the primary IT point of contact for wastewater operations and lead a dedicated infrastructure and applications support team. With a proactive mindset, you will seek opportunities for continuous improvement and be unafraid to dive into hands-on work when needed, ensuring the technologies you oversee are effectively supported day to day. This role is accountable for how IT “shows up” for wastewater operations, ensuring systems are reliable, secure, compliant, and aligned with business, safety, regulatory, and county policy requirements.
  
  
Key Responsibilities

* Maintain and enhance on-premises infrastructure including server rooms, servers, virtualization, operating systems, databases, storage, backups, and monitoring using technologies such as VMware, Windows Server, SQL Server, and related tools.

* Develop, implement, and govern IT/OT policies, procedures, standards, and ITIL aligned service management processes including incident, problem, change, capacity planning, CMDB and asset management, and disaster recovery.
* Produce and report IT system performance and utilization metrics and oversee strategic IT planning, budgeting, and prioritization of major initiatives while managing the WWM IT/OT budget including capital and operating expenditures.
* Supervise, mentor, and develop an IT operations focused team by assessing training needs, building cross training plans, and ensuring 24/7 coverage for critical applications and infrastructure.
* Lead 24/7 support, incident response coordination, and restoration of SCADA/OT and wastewater network systems and support emergency operations and continuity of operations plans.
* Develop and maintain WWM’s long range IT strategic plan, introduce and evaluate new technologies, and build collaborative relationships with division leaders and user groups to address operational challenges and guide system enhancements.

  
The ideal candidate must have:

* Strong communication and collaboration skills to maintain open, effective coordination with DIT, DPWES IT, and all WWM divisions.
* Strategic thinking mindset to align IT initiatives with long-term organizational goals and advance WWM’s technology roadmap.
* Leadership and coaching abilities to guide IT staff, cultivate talent, and foster a high-performing team.
* Effective problem-solving and decision-making skills to address system issues and support complex technology integrations.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and thrive in a fast-paced, mission-critical operational environment.
* Strong relationship-building skills to work across diverse functional units, user groups, and internal/external stakeholders.

Cole, Jr. Water Recycling Facility in Lorton, VA, but also serves numerous wastewater pump stations throughout Fairfax County and the Water Resources and Infrastructure facility located in Burke, VA.

Title: Manager Data Center Operations
Description:
**Manager Data Center Operations**

**Your role**

The Manager Data Center Operationsis responsible for overseeing the execution of local data center operations at one or more data center properties. Data center operations include, but are not limited to:

* Engineering operations and core infrastructure maintenance
* Data center construction management, commissioning and start-up
* Delivery of data center services including colocation, connectivity, raised floor services and deployment
* Installation and management of all cable and network infrastructure supporting facility and customer connectivity
* Technical event management including post-event root cause analysis and infrastructure repair

**What you’ll do**

* Execute all aspects of data center operations including the operation, maintenance and repair of all mission critical equipment and systems supporting a 24x7 data center operation to achieve 100% uptime and 100% compliance with all customer SLAs.
* Supervises all construction activity and installations, in coordination with internal and external construction resources, to ensure system design, installation and testing adhere to operational standards.
* Witness testing of all equipment during commissioning and validate sequence of operations and receipt of all operational documentation.
* Manages provisioning of data center services including colocation, connectivity, raised floor services, deployment and any additional services to be delivered to data center customers.
* Manages all local customer installations, in coordination with Sales Engineering, Design & Construction and Colocation Operations to coordinate customer move-ins and turn-ups, including deployments, power circuit installations and connectivity requirements.
* Oversees local installation, maintenance and repair of all network infrastructure supporting all Digital Realty and customer connectivity in coordination with internal IT and network personnel.
* Supervise local engineering team to ensure adherence to standard operating procedures, sequence of operations and maintenance standards to guarantee execution of Digital Realty’s periodic maintenance program and maintenance calendar.
* Develop, implement and audit local standard operating procedures, sequence of operations and maintenance standards to be in compliance with Digital Realty’s standards and industry best practices.
* Supervise local change management processes including the review and approval of all Method of Procedures (MOPs) for maintenance and one-time/emergency repair events in coordination with onsite personnel, contractors and customers.
* Manage all maintenance and repair contracts to ensure compliance with maintenance standards and operational requirements. Confirm all vendors are qualified and adhere to Digital Realty’s performance standards and scopes of work.
* Responsible for timely execution of data center services such as remote hands, customer installations and service requests.
* Supervise security personnel and manage security systems including the adherence to security policies and compliance programs (as required by the Property Manager)
* Act as primary technical and operational contact for data center customers – both as the technical lead and local point of escalation during emergency events and day to day operations. Develop knowledge of customer’s core business and the business function of the customer’s local datacenter operation.
* Manage technical and operational incidents at the property, including the implementation of emergency response procedures, resource coordination, customer communication, root-cause analysis and post event remediation.
* Identify trends and analyze risks to articulate implications and impact to data center operations. Track operational metrics and other data to provide Senior Management oversight and control for both snapshot data and long-term trend analysis.
* Identify process based improvements that generate operational and financial efficiencies including the development and presentation of the business case.
* Support Property Manager with the management of expenses and assist all budgeting, forecasting and reporting requirements by providing capital and expense requirements and justifications.
* Support pre-sales process, including, but not limited to, conducting sales tours and reviewing lease proposals and lease agreements to confirm compliance with Digital Realty standards and local requirements.
* Support various accreditation initiatives, including, but not limited to, SSAE16, SOC2, ISO 27001, etc. as may be required by Digital Realty.
* Maintain compliance with local health & safety (i.e. OSHA) standards and national electrical and building codes.

**What you’ll need**

* 10 years related facility management experience in data center operations (or related electrical or mechanical engineering field) with minimum of 5 years’ experience managing or leading data center operations teams in a large scale mission critical environment. Bachelor’s degree in electrical or mechanical engineering preferred.
* Solid and proven experience in the construction, commissioning, acceptance and operation of mission critical systems, including state-of-the-art electrical distribution systems, static and rotary UPS, emergency standby generation, fire alarm/suppression and monitoring systems
* Extensive knowledge of structured cabling systems, networking and connectivity standards, and hardware installation requirements.
* Proficient experience in colocation operations, including the installation and deployment of cage, rack and cable infrastructure, as well as, power circuit installation and power monitoring.
* Experience working with and deploying telecom and network providers, specifically in Meet Me Room and POP room environments
* Experience managing a change control environment
* Strong quantitative and qualitative reasoning skills, with demonstrated ability to determine event root causes, performance shortfalls and required corrective actions.
* Knowledge of industry data center standards, policies & methodologies
* Knowledge of performance management & critical awareness methods and implementation standards
* Strong interpersonal, presentation and communication skills
* Strong organizational skills and detail oriented
* Experience managing own budget and analyzing expenses
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook and familiarity with Microsoft Project, Visio or AutoCad
* Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM), and power metering system

**A bit about us**

Digital Realty brings companies and data together by delivering the full spectrum of data center, colocation and interconnection solutions. PlatformDIGITAL®, the company’s global data center platform, provides customers with a secure data meeting place and a proven Pervasive Datacenter Architecture (PDx®) solution methodology for powering innovation and efficiently managing Data Gravity challenges. Digital Realty gives its customers access to the connected data communities that matter to them with a global data center footprint of 300+ facilities in 50+ metros across 25+ countries on six continents.

  

**Operations**

Our Operations team keeps our customers’ infrastructure running safely and securely. We get plenty of opportunities to take on a variety of tasks and develop our technical skills. From overseeing electrical power to cooling and fire suppression systems, our team plays a vital role in making sure everything in our data centers operates as it should.

  

**What we can offer you**

Our rapidly evolving business sector offers the opportunity to be part of a courageous and passionate team who work together to understand and meet the changing needs of our global customers.

  

Join us and you’ll be part of a supportive and inclusive environment where you can bring your whole self to work. As part of our team, you’ll get to work with people from different business areas, challenge the way we do things and put your ideas into action. We’ll also give you plenty of development opportunities so you can build a rewarding and successful career with us.

  

Apply today, take charge of your career and grow your talents with us.

  

**Health and Safety**

Safety isn't just a priority here at Digital; it's critical to everything we do. Safeguarding lives, protecting assets, and securing data aren't just ideals - they're essential pillars of our commitment to excellence for our people, our partners and our customers. We have a culture of care where every member of Team Digital embraces a relentless pursuit of working safely across Digital Realty. Together we are Safely Powering Progress.

Digital Realty offers its employees a highly competitive compensation package, excellent benefits, and an environment that recognizes and rewards your contributions. Central to our compensation philosophy is rewarding our employees for achieving the values and objectives aligned to the company's overall goals and values.

Title: Senior Program Manager, Network Build
Description:
**Senior Program Manager, Network Build**
=========================================

  

**HELP CONNECT ARIZONA. BUILD THE FUTURE OF BROADBAND**.

At Wecom Fiber, we're helping bridge the digital divide across Arizona by building and maintaining the communications infrastructure that powers homes, businesses, schools, and communities. As our next Senior Manager of Field Operations Support, you'll play a key leadership role in scaling operations, improving performance, and helping shape the future of a rapidly growing telecommunications organization.

  

**WHY WECOM?**

At Wecom, we believe exceptional people deserve more than a paycheck.

We're building a workplace where employees can grow their careers, make an impact, and help shape the future of telecommunications across Arizona. Our employees are helping connect communities, expand broadband access, and bring meaningful technology infrastructure to underserved areas throughout the state.

  

**Department:** Enterprise Program Management

**Reports to:** Senior Director of Enterprise Program Management

**Location:** Arizona – Statewide (Field/Hybrid)

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Senior Program Manager, Network Build leads the delivery of fiber network construction across one or more markets and the Design Areas within them. This role owns the plan for each market from an accepted design package through an operational network, and is accountable for keeping every Design Area moving through the same sixteen milestones, from package accepted to operational. The Senior Program Manager sets the standard for how the Network Build Program Managers plan, report and escalate, and is the primary voice of the build program to senior leaders. The role also helps build and refine the processes the team runs on, so that planning, handoffs, reporting and vendor payment become more consistent and more efficient as the program grows.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Plan and schedule ownership**

* Own the schedule and plan logic for assigned markets, including dependencies, crew capacity, quantities, production rates and weather effects, and keep them accurate as work moves from Project Controls to the Network Build team.

* Maintain the sixteen-milestone plan for every Design Area, and decide when a milestone is complete using evidence from the responsible team rather than assumption.

* Re-forecast dates when crew counts, weather, permits or materials change, and explain the effect on the market finish date.

  

**Milestone management and handoffs**

* Confirm the Operational state of each Design Area. The Senior Program Manager and the Network Build Program Managers confirm it; no other team does.

* Manage the release of each project to construction, including the handoff to Supply Chain for materials staging and the notice to Sales and Marketing.

* In Prescott, run the pre-construction approval sequence: Construction completes the utility locates and reports to the Program Manager, the Program Manager schedules the pre-construction walks, Design and Engineering makes comments and corrections, the City approves, and Construction is then released.

  

**Cross-functional leadership**

* Coordinate Design and Engineering, the Permit Specialist, Supply Chain, Construction, Sales and Marketing and the Network Operations Center so that each handoff is clean and dated.

* Hold a weekly meeting with each team on Thursday or Friday, collect final updates by Monday, and prepare the reports for the Wednesday 30-60-90 day review.

* Escalate risks, delays and decisions early, with a recommendation and the effect on schedule and cost.

  

**Vendor and financial oversight**

* Make sure construction vendors are paid accurately and on time by reviewing each submitted invoice against the approved design prints before it is entered for payment.

* Track budget against forecast for each Design Area and flag variances to leadership.

  

**Reporting and governance**

* Report status using four labels: On Track, At-Risk, Off-Track and Complete.

* Track grant-funded markets against their commitments and prepare the reporting those programs require.

* Review the plan data for accuracy each week, and correct gaps before reports are issued.

* Communicate directly with executives and senior leaders in writing and in meetings, presenting status, risks, decisions and recommendations in plain language with the conclusion first.

  

**Team leadership**

* Coach and review the work of the Network Build Program Managers, set consistent reporting standards, and step in on the most complex or at-risk markets.

  

**Process development and improvement**

* Help design and document the processes the Network Build team follows, including milestone definitions, handoffs between teams, schedule updates, reporting and vendor invoice review.

* Review how the processes work in practice each quarter, identify recurring delays, rework and gaps, and recommend and lead improvements.

* Turn lessons from completed Design Areas into updated standards, templates and checklists that every Network Build Program Manager uses.

* Work with Design and Engineering, Permitting, Supply Chain, Construction, Sales and Marketing and the Network Operations Center to agree on process changes before they are adopted.

* Train and coach the Network Build Program Managers on new and revised processes, and confirm that they are followed.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required**

* A bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, business or a related field, or equivalent experience.

* At least eight years of program or project management experience, including at least five years delivering outside plant fiber, utility or telecommunications construction.

* Demonstrated ability to manage schedules with dependencies, crew capacity and weather, and to explain a forecast change in plain language.

* Experience managing construction vendors, including invoice review against design documents.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing and presenting executive-level status reports, briefings and recommendations that are clear, accurate and concise.

  

**Preferred**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent.

* Experience with federal or state broadband grant programs.

* Experience with permitting for rights-of-way, railroad, highway and utility pole attachments.

* Experience leading or mentoring other program managers.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Every Design Area in the assigned markets shows an accurate, current date for each milestone.

* Forecast dates move when crews, weather or permits change, and leaders hear about the change before the weekly review.

* Vendor invoices are verified against the design prints and paid without rework.

* Handoffs between teams happen on the planned date, with no team waiting for another.

* Processes are documented, current and followed, and improvements that came from completed Design Areas are visible in the team's standards and templates.

  

**THE BENEFITS OF JOINING OUR TEAM**

**Career Growth & Leadership Opportunity**

* Build scalable systems and processes

* Lead transformational initiatives

* Shape the future of construction management at Wecom

Title: VP, Head of Cloud Solutions
Description:
**JOB SUMMARY:**

We are seeking a senior technology leader to own CFSB's cloud strategy, platform engineering, and cloud operating model. Reporting to the [CIO/CTO], this role owns the multi-year cloud roadmap and leads the team that builds and runs the bank's cloud platform — the landing zones, automation, networking, and controls that every other technology team builds on.

This is a hands-on leadership role in a regulated environment. You should be equally comfortable presenting a cloud investment case to executive leadership, reviewing an infrastructure-as-code pull request with an engineer, and explaining to an examiner how cloud controls are designed and evidenced. We expect recommendations and tradeoffs, not problems to be assigned.

The role manages five to eight cloud engineers and partners closely with Information Security, Risk, Compliance, Enterprise Architecture, and the product squads. You are the accountable technology owner for how security and regulatory requirements are implemented and evidenced in the cloud. The team participates in a shared on-call rotation and provides after-hours support to the business; this role serves as its senior escalation point.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

***Cloud Strategy and Roadmap***

* Own and maintain the multi-year cloud strategy and migration roadmap, sequenced against business priorities, risk appetite, and budget cycles.
* Translate strategy into executive-ready business cases and committee-level materials, and secure funding and alignment for cloud investments.
* Set cloud target architecture and standards with Enterprise Architecture — reference patterns, approved services, and guardrails for what teams may build.
* Define and report program metrics — migration progress, platform reliability, control coverage, and unit cost trends — and advise leaders on build-versus-buy and cloud-versus-on-premises decisions.

***Platform and Infrastructure Engineering***

* Lead the design, build, and operation of the cloud platform: multi-account landing zones, identity and access, network architecture and hybrid connectivity, observability, backup, and resilience.
* Establish infrastructure-as-code and pipeline-based delivery as the default provisioning mechanism, and eliminate manual, undocumented change.
* Own the cloud CI/CD, container, and DevOps tooling that squads consume, and enforce engineering standards for code review, environment promotion, change management, and documentation.
* Ensure environments meet availability and recovery objectives; lead resilience testing and serve as senior escalation point for major incidents through to permanent corrective action.

***Cloud Security, Risk, and Regulatory Compliance***

* Own the implementation and evidencing of cloud technical controls that satisfy policies and standards set by Information Security, Risk, and Compliance, and escalate gaps where cloud reality and policy diverge.
* Serve as the cloud subject matter expert in internal audit, external audit, and regulatory examinations, including FFIEC and GLBA obligations, and produce control evidence and remediation plans.
* Embed guardrails as code — configuration baselines, encryption and key management, privileged access controls, and continuous compliance monitoring — and remediate findings and drift to agreed timelines.
* Contribute cloud expertise to risk assessments, third-party technology reviews, and change and exception review boards; provide input to cloud policies as a reviewer, with ownership, approval, and risk acceptance resting with the second-line functions.

* Own the cloud budget: forecast spend, cost savings plan, and explain variances to Finance and the [CIO/CTO].
* Manage the AWS relationship, including account team engagement, support tier decisions, and technical escalation; provide technical input to procurement and renewals, with commercial negotiation led by Procurement and Vendor Management.

* Balance squad-embedded assignments against core platform work as priorities shift, and represent cloud engineering in technology leadership forums.

Title: Incident Manager
Description:
**About Peraton**
Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.
  
  
**About The Role**
Peraton is looking for an
**Incident Manager**
to join our Team. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills, with excellent time management and attention to detail. Effective written and verbal communication skills are key, with strong critical-thinking abilities, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively as a team. These qualities are essential to successfully managing and resolving high-priority incidents in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
**Work Location:**
This is a remote position with core working hours of 8am - 5pm EST
  
  
**What You Will Do:**

* Lead the coordination and management of impacting incidents to ensure timely service restoration while minimizing disruption to customers and business operations.
* Execute the enterprise Incident Management process, including monitoring incident queues, prioritizing incidents, and coordinating escalations to drive timely resolution.
* Facilitate the global response and coordination of major incidents affecting mission-critical business applications and infrastructure services in a 24/7/365 environment.
* Lead major incident communications by providing timely, accurate, and consistent updates to customers, stakeholders, and leadership throughout the incident life-cycle.
* Review and validate major incident notifications to ensure communications are complete, accurate, and appropriate for the intended audience.
* Leverage incident and problem management tools to track incidents, maintain detailed incident logs, document resolutions, and prepare reports for management review.
* Apply technical knowledge across infrastructure, applications, security, and performance management to support incident investigation and resolution.
* Collaborate with technical teams, Service Desk personnel, and other stakeholders to troubleshoot complex hardware and software issues and drive incidents toward resolution.
* Identify recurring incidents and potential trends, partnering with Problem Management teams to support root cause analysis and prevent future disruptions.
* Drive continuous improvement of the Incident Management life-cycle, including incident response procedures, escalation processes, and post-incident reviews.
* Develop, maintain, and improve technical documentation, operational procedures, and process guidelines for the Incident Management team.
* Build and maintain strong relationships across the organization to support critical incidents, including high-profile business events and time-sensitive operations.
* Remain composed and effective in high-pressure situations while managing competing priorities and coordinating multiple teams during critical incidents.
* Participate in an on-call rotation and provide incident management support outside of standard business hours, as needed, to ensure 24/7 service coverage.
* Maintain flexibility in work schedule to support business needs and incident response requirements.

**Problem Management**

* Engage with and assist the Problem Management team during Problem Investigations
* Utilize problem management reports to validate if any open problem known errors when handling high-priority incidents.
* Proactively and reactively, look for solutions to prevent problems from occurring in team/technology area.

**Change Management/Implementation**

* Utilize change management reports during a high-priority incident to validate if incident could be caused by change.
* Independently review, implement, and verify changes/solutions of high complexity and risk to meet customer and/or trade/IT infrastructure needs.
* May participate in a Change Advisory Board.

**Customer Relationship Management**

* Becoming a trusted advisor to the customer.

**Teamwork**

* Work as part of a team, which may be virtual, global, and/or multi-functional.
* Lead teams which address operational processes and policies in work area.
* Seen as a resource to the team in one or more technical or business areas.
* Becoming a trusted advisor inside and outside the team/technology area.

**Qualifications**
**Basic Qualifications:**

* Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust level clearance
* Must be willing to undergo a pre-employment credit check as required by the Customer.
* Bachelor's Degree and 5 years of experience, a Master's Degree and 3 years of experience, an Associate's Degree and 7 years of experience, or a High School Diploma or equivalent and 9 years of experience
* 3+ years of relevant experience in Customer Service, Incident Management, or general project management
* Familiarity and understanding of IT Service Management tools (Remedy, JIRA, ServiceNow, etc.)
* Working knowledge of the technology, applications, and infrastructure within areas of responsibility
* Ability to effectively coordinate technical teams during incident investigation and resolution
* Developing and maintaining relationships with customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure effective communication, collaboration, and coordination throughout the incident management life-cycle
* Proficiency with MS Office: Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* ITIL Foundations Certification
* One or more of the following Incident Response related certifications: Threat Handling Foundations certificate, Certified in Cybersecurity (CC), Practical SOC Analyst Associate (PSAA), OffSec Incident Responder (OSIR), or Certified Incident Handler (ECIH)

**Details**

Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Description:

**We’re looking for our next Team Lead, System Reliability Engineering**
We are searching for a Team Lead, System Reliability Engineering to guide, mentor, and scale the engineering squad responsible for our platform stability. At Questrade, we don’t just watch dashboards, we build the intelligence that anticipates failures. Our mission is to achieve absolute reliability and resilience, ensuring our high-frequency trading platforms remain unshakable under the pressure of global markets.
  
  
In this role, you will lead a team of talented SREs who don't just fix problems in Production, they engineer out their possibilities. You are a player-coach and an evangelist for Site/System Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles who views manual toil as a bug to be automated. Most importantly, you will set the technical vision for how your team leverages Machine Learning (ML) and Large Language Models (LLMs) to transform reactive operations into predictive, self-healing systems.
  
  
**The mandate**
**Your Domain: Leading at the Intersection of SRE & AI**
As The Team Lead, System Reliability Engineering Within The Questrade Experience Platform Engineering Group, You Will Balance Hands-on Architectural Leadership With People Management. Your Playground Involves
  
  

* Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead, coach, and grow a squad of System Reliability Engineers. Conduct 1:1s, drive career development, foster a culture of psychological safety and high accountability, and manage capacity across sprint work and on-call rotations.
* SRE Strategy & Governance: Champion SRE best practices across the engineering organization. Guide your team and partner squads in defining and managing SLIs, SLOs, and Error Budgets to balance the velocity of innovation with the necessity of stability.
* AI-Powered Operational Vision: Spearhead the roadmap for applying ML models to "Smart Alerting" and anomaly detection, guiding your team to move beyond static thresholds toward systems that understand patterns and mitigate outages before they happen.
* Autonomous Resilience: Oversee the architecture and implementation of self-healing workflows. Whether it's auto-scaling GKE clusters or building LLM-assisted incident response playbooks, you are steering the development of the "autopilot" for our production environments.
* Cloud Native Excellence: Set the architectural standard for orchestrating highly available systems using GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine), Terraform, and Helm, ensuring our infrastructure is declarative, versioned, and resilient.
* Executive Incident Command: Serve as an escalation point and Principal Incident Commander during critical, high-severity incidents. Lead cross-functional "War Rooms" with Engineering, DBAs, Network teams, and Executive stakeholders, and champion a blameless post-mortem culture to drive long-term system improvement.
* Domain Expertise: Strong foundational knowledge of trading systems is desired but not required.

**You’re ready for this mandate if you have the following qualifications**
You are a high-level problem solver and inspiring technical leader who bridges the gap between deep systems knowledge, software engineering, and people management.
  
  
**Leadership & Strategic Execution**

* Proven Team Leadership: 7+ years of experience in System Reliability or DevOps engineering, including 2+ years in a formal Team Lead, Tech Lead, or Engineering Management capacity mentoring and managing engineers.
* Cross-Functional Influence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to align engineering squads, product owners, and executive leadership around reliability roadmaps, error budgets, and architectural investments.
* Blameless Culture Builder: You foster an environment where engineers feel safe to experiment, own mistakes, and learn rapidly through rigorous, blameless post-mortems.

**Your Technical Arsenal**

* Automating Support: Strong software engineering background with mastery of Python, C#, and Bash to guide code reviews and build scalable automation frameworks.
* Cloud & Orchestration: Mastery of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE); advanced proficiency in container orchestration and IaC using Kubernetes (kubectl), Helm, and Terraform.
* Modern Observability: Advanced capability in Splunk (Administration/Querying) and Datadog, with experience architecting AI-enhanced observability and dashboards.
* System Versatility: Strong experience with Linux systems and a solid understanding of Windows IIS server, enabling you to guide troubleshooting across a diverse application stack.
* Database & Network Mastery: Strong grasp of MS SQL/MySQL and a deep understanding of network protocols (TCP/IP, UDP).

**Mastery of the Incident Lifecycle**

* Incident Command & Escalation: Act as the senior lead during high-severity events, coordinating between Engineering, DBA, Network, and Executive stakeholders to drive rapid service restoration and clear communication.
* The "Resolution First" Mindset: You possess the technical intuition to quickly distinguish between symptoms and root causes under pressure, guiding your team in applying immediate remediation followed by systemic fixes to eliminate technical debt.
* Automated Incident Response: You champion the use of Python, Bash, and AI-driven tools to automate common remediation patterns (e.g., auto-restarting stalled pods, triggering failovers, or clearing cache bottlenecks).
* Predictive Analysis: Lead initiatives using AI and smart alerting to identify "near-misses"—anomalies that didn't cause an outage this time, but will if left unaddressed.

**The SRE Mindset**

* Toil’s Worst Enemy: You relentlessly protect your team's engineering bandwidth by prioritizing the automation of repetitive operational tasks.
* AI Champion: You actively explore and advocate for how Generative AI can summarize logs, accelerate root cause analyses, and elevate internal documentation.
* Resilient Under Pressure: You model calm, decisive leadership in high-pressure trading environments, including managing team on-call rotations and market-critical batch windows.

**Why You’ll Thrive at Questrade**

* Leading the Fintech Frontier: Work at the center of Canada's most innovative brokerage, where your team's reliability directly protects and empowers the financial future of our clients.
* A Culture of Ownership: You aren't a cog; you are a decision-maker. We empower you to shape team strategy, propose architectural shifts, and lead high-impact technical investments.
* Infinite Learning: We don't just support your growth—we demand it. From AI workshops and leadership development to advanced cloud certifications, you and your team will be constantly evolving.

***Enter your career inflection point. Apply now.***

Title: Vice President, Infrastructure Services & Information Security
Description:
**Why We Are - Who We Are:** About FFF Enterprises
  
What We Do - https://www.fffenterprises.com/company/what-we-do.html
  
  
Position Summary
  
The Vice President, Infrastructure Services & Information Security leads the strategy, engineering, delivery, and operation of enterprise infrastructure services and information security across FFF Enterprises and its affiliated businesses. The position is accountable for the reliability, scalability, resilience, and security of technology platforms and services, including cloud and on-premises infrastructure, networks and communications, digital workplace and end-user services, distribution center technology, cybersecurity operations, and enterprise information protection.
  
The role establishes and executes integrated infrastructure and information security roadmaps, operating standards, service ownership models, security controls, and continuous improvement priorities aligned with enterprise technology strategy, business requirements, and regulatory obligations. Responsibilities include technology service delivery, operational resilience, information security governance, cyber risk management, vulnerability and third-party security oversight, incident preparedness and response, and secure adoption of emerging technologies.
  
Through leadership of multidisciplinary technical teams and collaboration with business and technology stakeholders, the Vice President strengthens service reliability, security effectiveness, operational performance, and organizational capabilities. The position provides informed recommendations to executive leadership regarding technology investments, material risks, operational priorities, and performance outcomes while supporting established escalation, risk acceptance, and independent assurance processes.
  
  
Essential Functions and Duties
  
Enterprise Technology & Security Strategy, Governance & Roadmaps:
  

* Lead integrated infrastructure services and information security planning, establishing multi-year roadmaps aligned with enterprise technology strategy, business growth, critical service needs, and applicable security requirements.
* Define organizational design, service ownership, roles, decision rights, and escalation practices across infrastructure engineering, operations, cybersecurity, security governance, and supporting vendors.
* Establish common planning and review cadences for service performance, security posture, investment decisions, remediation priorities, material incidents, and continuous improvement.
* Advise executive leadership on technology modernization, emerging threats, resilience, automation, AI, and the balance among service quality, security, risk, and cost.

**Cloud & Platform Engineering:**  

* Lead cloud and platform services across Azure, Google Cloud, Nutanix, operating systems, compute, storage, backup integration, identity integration, infrastructure as code, and cloud financial management.
* Establish platform engineering standards that strengthen availability, scalability, security hardening, configuration consistency, automation, and lifecycle management.
* Oversee platform modernization, technical debt reduction, capacity planning, patching coordination, and cloud consumption governance while maintaining secure architecture and change controls.
* Ensure infrastructure configurations, privileged access, logging, and recovery capabilities support applicable security and operational requirements.

**Network & Communications:**  

* Direct enterprise and distribution center network services, including WAN, wireless, cloud connectivity, internet redundancy, DNS/DHCP, VPN, voice, and collaboration systems.
* Establish network architecture, segmentation, resilience, capacity, monitoring, and lifecycle standards for reliable and secure connectivity.
* Define engineering ownership, operational escalation, and security responsibilities for network access, perimeter protections, and business-critical network services.

**Digital Workplace, End User Services & IT Service Management:**  

* Lead digital workplace and employee technology services for office, remote, hybrid, and distribution center personnel, including endpoint engineering, mobile management, Microsoft 365, collaboration, provisioning, patching, and device lifecycle.
* Oversee service desk operations and IT service management practices across incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, asset, and service catalog management.
* Govern endpoint security integration, asset inventory, administrative controls, secure configuration, licensing, vendor services, and secure device disposition.
* Establish measurable employee service outcomes, service levels, ownership, and continuous improvement practices across supported environments.

Site Reliability, Operational Resilience & Business Continuity:
  

* Lead monitoring and observability, service reliability engineering, incident management, root-cause analysis, backup validation, capacity management, disaster recovery, and operational readiness for critical business services.
* Establish recovery objectives, resilient designs, redundancy requirements, continuity exercises, and recovery testing aligned with critical business processes and security scenarios.
* Direct coordinated operational response to major technology availability incidents, including service restoration, escalation, stakeholder communications, root-cause analysis, and corrective action.
* Coordinate infrastructure recovery and business continuity capabilities with information security incident response planning, including ransomware resilience and recovery testing.

**Warehouse & Distribution Center Technology Enablement:**  

* Oversee distribution center technology enablement, including warehouse wireless services, RF devices, scanners, printers, shipping workstations, local infrastructure, and site support.
* Coordinate technology dependencies for warehouse control systems, automation and conveyor interfaces, PLC connectivity, site upgrades, and peak-period readiness with Operations and vendors.
* Establish support boundaries, cybersecurity coordination, availability expectations, and escalation pathways for operational technology and warehouse infrastructure.
* Ensure appropriate business-critical recovery, segmentation, resilience, monitoring, and security controls for distribution center technology.

**Information Security Program, Architecture & Operations:**  

* Direct the enterprise information security program across FFF and applicable affiliated businesses, safeguarding confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information and technology assets.
* Develop and maintain security strategy, policies, technical standards, control baselines, information classification, and security architecture aligned to enterprise operating requirements.
* Oversee security monitoring, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, endpoint and network protection, identity and privileged access security, security configuration, and remediation governance.
* Establish enterprise processes for identifying and evaluating cyber threats, reviewing emerging technologies, and embedding security into technology architecture, product development, procurement, and change management.
* Guide security capabilities and qualified internal or external specialists to provide risk-informed protection of platforms, applications, networks, sensitive information, and technology services.
* Develop security awareness and role-based training programs, promoting informed, accountable security behaviors among employees, contractors, and approved users.

**Cyber Risk, Information Protection & Third-Party Assurance:**  

* Establish and maintain the enterprise information security risk assessment process, including threat evaluation, control assessment, risk treatment tracking, and documentation of material exposures.
* Oversee cybersecurity reviews of technology suppliers and material third parties, including contractual security requirements, assessment findings, remediation commitments, and ongoing risk monitoring.
* Coordinate with business owners, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and Audit on information ownership, data classification, secure handling, retention, and protection requirements.
* Report material cybersecurity risks, control deficiencies, third-party exposures, exceptions, and remediation status to designated leadership and risk governance stakeholders.
* Establish clear processes for identifying, assessing, documenting, escalating, and monitoring information security risks, ensuring material risk acceptance and independent assurance activities remain subject to established enterprise governance and designated approval authority.

**Security Policy, Regulatory Compliance & Audit:**  

* Lead development, maintenance, implementation, and communication of practical enterprise information security policies, standards, and procedures.
* Partner with Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and Internal Audit to evaluate applicable obligations and control expectations, including HIPAA, PCI DSS, CCPA/CPRA, and other relevant requirements as determined by the business.
* Coordinate security control assessments, audit evidence, remediation plans, and management responses in partnership with Legal, Compliance, and Internal Audit, while respecting their independent responsibilities.
* Use risk-based frameworks such as NIST and ISO 27001, where appropriate, to inform security maturity assessments, control effectiveness measures, and improvement roadmaps.
* Track security policy exceptions, audit findings, control deficiencies, and overdue remediation, and communicate material developments through established governance channels.

**Cybersecurity Incident Response & Crisis Coordination:**  

* Direct and coordinate preparedness, detection, containment, investigation, recovery, and lessons learned during material information security incidents.
* Convene and coordinate designated security incident response resources and business stakeholders, with clear authority, severity classifications, playbooks, escalation triggers, and communication processes.
* Coordinate with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, executive leadership, and external specialists on notification assessments, law enforcement engagement, evidence preservation, and crisis communications, as applicable.
* Oversee incident response exercises, technical readiness, external incident response retainers, and improvement activities following security events.
* Escalate material cybersecurity incidents promptly and coordinate technical recovery with operational continuity and established legal and crisis management processes.

**Infrastructure Architecture, Automation & Responsible AI:**  

* Establish infrastructure architecture standards, reference designs, engineering practices, lifecycle planning, interoperability, and secure target-state direction.
* Advance infrastructure automation, orchestration, reusable platforms, self-service capabilities, and responsible AI-assisted operational tools with appropriate controls and human oversight.
* Coordinate with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, and AI governance stakeholders to assess information protection, system access, reliability, and operational risks before new technology adoption.
* Prioritize emerging technology investments based on measurable service improvement, security outcomes, business value, operational complexity, and cost.

**Financial, Vendor & Performance Management:**  

* Own approved infrastructure and information security operating budgets, financial plans, contracts, vendor performance, resource allocations, and delivery commitments within established financial authority.
* Develop business cases and investment recommendations addressing resilience, modernization, technical debt, security maturity, regulatory exposure, and risk reduction.
* Establish integrated service and security measures for reliability, incident response, recovery, vulnerability remediation, control effectiveness, audit progress, service quality, customer experience, and cost.
* Provide regular reporting to executive leadership on service performance, material risk, financial results, investment progress, incident trends, vendor outcomes, and roadmap commitments.
* Maintain effective vendor governance for technical service levels, security obligations, incident response support, contractual performance, and required corrective actions.

**Organization, Workforce & Talent Leadership:**  

* Build and develop a high-performing combined Infrastructure Services and Information Security organization with clear functional leadership, accountability, technical expertise, and appropriate segregation of duties.
* Lead multi-year workforce and capability planning, succession, critical-role coverage, insourcing and outsourcing decisions, vendor augmentation, and targeted capability development.
* Develop leaders, managers, engineers, and security practitioners through coaching, performance management, cross-training, knowledge transfer, and career development.
* Promote a culture of engineering excellence, service ownership, proactive risk identification, ethical decision-making, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.

Education, Knowledge, Skills, and Experience
  
  
**Required Education:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field.

**Preferred Education:**  

* Advanced degree in technology leadership, cybersecurity, business administration, or related discipline.

**Required Knowledge:**  

* Enterprise infrastructure architecture and operations across public and private cloud, networking, endpoints, collaboration, identity services, and IT service management.
* Information security governance, cyber risk assessment, security architecture, threat and vulnerability management, identity and access security, incident response, and third-party assurance.
* High-availability engineering, observability, disaster recovery, business continuity, and secure technology lifecycle management.
* Recognized security and risk frameworks, security control assessment, and applicable privacy and compliance considerations, including HIPAA and other relevant regulations.
* Budgeting, vendor governance, service metrics, security performance reporting, and enterprise technology investment planning.

**Preferred Knowledge:**  

* Azure, Google Cloud, Nutanix, Microsoft 365, Intune, Jamf, RingCentral, Terraform, or comparable technology ecosystems.
* NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-53, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and security architecture or risk governance practices.
* Distribution center wireless, warehouse automation, operational technology, and high-availability transaction environments.
* Responsible AI-assisted operations, security monitoring automation, modern identity security, and cloud security practices.
* Pharmaceutical distribution, specialty healthcare services, or other regulated and business-critical operating environments.

**Required Experience:**  

* Minimum of fifteen (15) years of progressive information technology experience, including at least seven (7) years in senior technology leadership.
* Demonstrated senior-level leadership across enterprise infrastructure services and information security, including accountability for multidisciplinary technical teams, operational performance, cyber risk management, and enterprise technology initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience directing cloud, network, digital workplace, service operations, resilience, and cyber risk or information security programs in complex, distributed organizations.
* Experience directing or overseeing security incident response, risk assessments, control remediation, security assessments, and communication of material risks to executive leadership.
* Experience building and executing multi-year roadmaps, managing budgets and vendors, developing organizational capabilities, and delivering measurable technology and risk outcomes.

**Preferred Experience:**  

* Experience holding a CISO, head of information security, or comparable enterprise security leadership mandate.
* Leadership of technology services for distribution centers or other high-availability and regulated operations.
* Experience with hybrid cloud, SRE, modern service management, vulnerability management, and security operations maturity programs.
* Experience coordinating incident response with executive leadership, Legal, Compliance, auditors, regulators, insurers, or external response specialists as needed.
* Experience integrating infrastructure and information security functions while preserving appropriate risk escalation, independent assurance, and governance.

**Required Skills:**  

* Senior-level technology leadership with the ability to integrate infrastructure reliability, cybersecurity effectiveness, operational resilience, and disciplined resource management.
* Sound judgment during significant service and security incidents, clear escalation, crisis coordination, and concise communication to executive leadership and technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Ability to establish organizational accountability, service ownership, effective decision rights, and appropriate segregation of duties across engineering and security functions.
* Analytical leadership using service and security measures, risk assessments, root-cause analysis, business cases, and performance reviews to inform decisions.
* Strong stakeholder engagement, vendor management, negotiation, strategic planning, change leadership, and talent development skills.

**Preferred Skills:**  

* Applying security engineering and responsible AI capabilities to improve operational resilience, service quality, and control effectiveness.

**Required Professional Certification:**
